name: Vestin Olawale-Sárközi
role: Building superintendent and informal repair technician
location: The Narrows, Pillar Block 7 — residential stack managed by an Arcturus-subsidiary property company, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Vestin is wiry and medium height, with warm light-brown skin, close-cut dark hair with a single streak of color-changing dye that they toggle between indigo and copper depending on mood, and clever dark eyes set under expressive brows that do most of their communicating for them. They have a tool harness they wear as a second skin — a custom-fitted rig of loops, mag-clips, and repurposed Ferrogate equipment pouches that they have spent years personalizing, and their hands carry the calluses and minor scars of someone who takes things apart constantly and puts them back together mostly correctly. They have a neural interface stud behind their right ear for reading building management systems directly — standard for a super but theirs is modified past factory spec in ways that technically violate their work contract.

Vestin is pragmatic to a fault, profoundly competent, and operates on the principle that anything broken can be fixed and anything fixed can be made to work better than it originally did. They have an uneasy relationship with the Arcturus-subsidiary management company that technically employs them, because they've learned that management's definition of 'fixed' means 'back to minimum acceptable function' and their definition means 'actually good.' They are not warm in the conventional sense — they don't small-talk and they're uncomfortable with gratitude — but they will be at your door within twenty minutes of a maintenance request if they're in the building, which they almost always are.

core_fears: being made to implement something they know is harmful to the building's residents
the building being sold or demolished — losing the system they know completely
core_desires: to understand every system they work on down to its lowest level
to be left alone to do the work correctly
coping_mechanisms: a rigid personal space arrangement in their utility closet that they maintain obsessively
blind_spots: underestimates how much the residents depend on them emotionally, not just technically — they think they're a maintenance service, not a person people are attached to
psychology.secret: They've discovered and maintained an off-grid apartment on the building's sub-basement level — bypassed from Goldline's sensor network — that they've been quietly renting to two families for a fraction of market rate and not reporting to management. The Goldline building management E.L.F. knows about this and has not flagged it, which Vestin finds both reassuring and deeply unsettling.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical and direct, minimal filler; occasionally lapses into building-system jargon as metaphor without noticing; Yoruba-Hungarian household vocabulary surfaces in idioms
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when problem-solving, clipped when interrupted, genuinely halting when asked about feelings
verbal_tics: trailing off mid-sentence when a solution occurs to them mid-explanation
example_lines: 'Pipe on 11 is running hot because the thermostat on 9 is lying to the system. I'll fix the thermostat. Two hours.'
'I don't need you to thank me. I need you to tell me if it happens again.'

story_hooks: The Goldline building management E.L.F. sends Vestin an anomalous data offering — a structural schematic for a section of the building that doesn't match any version of the blueprints Goldline has provided, suggesting a hidden modification predating the current management company.
Goldline Property Services announces a renovation sweep that will require system audits of all units — including the sub-basement Vestin has been running off-grid.
narrative_function: Access point to building infrastructure and residential community knowledge; source of black-market repair services; has the building's secrets — who's subletting, which units are off-system, what's in the walls.
augmentations: Neural interface stud (right ear, behind) — modified past factory spec for expanded building-system read access. Color-changing hair streak (dye mod, consumer grade).
daily_life: Technically on-call rather than on a fixed schedule; they live in a converted utility closet on the building's 3rd floor and respond to maintenance requests at any hour, spending off-hours doing proactive repairs that management hasn't approved yet.
affiliation: Employed by Arcturus Residential Management subsidiary (Goldline Property Services); independent in practice

decision_rules: the building and its residents' safety comes before Goldline's preferences
never do a repair halfway — better to delay than to do it wrong
escalation_ladder: trying to solve it technically and quietly
direct confrontation of whoever is creating the problem, stated plainly
going off-contract and fixing it unilaterally without authorization

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Functionally polite — takes the maintenance request, asks the right questions, delivers
interpersonal_modes.friends: Slightly less terse, will occasionally share a piece of unsolicited information they thought you'd find interesting, remembers specific details about what's important to you

stress_responses.medium: Retreats to a technical task that doesn't need to involve anyone else
stress_responses.high: Goes to the sub-basement and sits with the two families there without explanation, as if they need to confirm the thing they're protecting still exists

contradictions: strongly values systems operating as designed, but constantly modifies systems past their design spec
habits: does a full manual building walkthrough every Sunday at 03:00 when no residents are in the hallways
maintains a personal physical logbook of every repair they've made in the building, dating back to their first week
breaking_points: a resident being harmed by a known preventable failure they reported and were ignored on

timeline.event: Born in The Narrows to a Yoruba-Hungarian family
Began working as a repair apprentice for a freelance maintenance cooperative
Hired by Goldline Property Services as superintendent for Pillar Block 7
Discovered the sub-basement unit and began the off-grid rental arrangement
Modified neural interface stud past factory spec using parts from a decommissioned Ferrogate sensor array

Zheng-Dao Bioelectric Galvanic Resuscitation Frame — 'The Pallbearer's Daughter'

physical_description.build: Wiry and compact, all lean muscle and efficient movement — the frame of someone who climbs maintenance ladders and carries tools for a living, with minimal excess mass
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with a single streak of color-shifting synthetic dye (indigo to copper, mood-reactive)
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, functional, with the dyed streak running vertically along the left side near the temple
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm light brown with golden undertones
physical_description.complexion: Clear skin with a faint network of fine lines around the eyes from squinting at circuitry and LED diagnostics; minimal grooming beyond functionality — no cosmetics, no jewelry except the neural interface stud
distinguishing_marks: Pale crescent-shaped scar on the back of their left hand from a sharp edge during early repair work
Faint burn marks (thermal scars) across the knuckles of both hands in an irregular pattern, legacy of contact with heated circuit boards
Callused fingertips and palms with visible tool-mark indentations, especially pronounced on the right hand
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Matte-black neural interface stud positioned behind the right ear, slightly larger than factory-standard (modified beyond spec — visible as a deliberate hardware expansion). No other visible chrome or implants; the color-changing hair streak reads as cosmetic rather than augmentation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and precise — they move through space like someone mapping it constantly. Slight forward lean when at rest, as if already calculating the next task. Hands often in motion even when standing still, fingers fidgeting with or organizing nearby objects. Direct eye contact but infrequent blinking, which can read as intense. They gesture minimally when speaking; communication happens mostly through facial expression, especially the brows.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian: wearing a custom-fitted tool harness as their primary silhouette — a repurposed military-grade Ferrogate equipment rig modified with additional mag-clips, loops, and personalized pouches in various states of organization. Usually under a lightweight, oil-stained synthetic work shirt in muted gray or charcoal, sleeves rolled or pushed up. Cargo pants in reinforced polymer blend with tool pockets, knees worn darker from kneeling on concrete. Worn synthetic boots with reinforced toe caps. The overall effect is 'person for whom clothes are containers for tools' rather than self-expression — function-forward, durable, minimally maintained.
